package http_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	httptransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http"
	adminhandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	apihandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type diagnosticHTTPStub struct {
	completed, planned int
	actor, plan        string
}

func (s *diagnosticHTTPStub) Complete(_ context.Context, actor, plan string) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error) {
	s.completed++
	s.actor, s.plan = actor, plan
	return domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState{Schema: "teacher-diagnostic-placement-state.v1", PlanID: plan, Status: "READY_FOR_PLANNING"}, nil
}
func (s *diagnosticHTTPStub) Plan(_ context.Context, actor, plan string) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error) {
	s.planned++
	s.actor, s.plan = actor, plan
	return domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState{Schema: "teacher-diagnostic-placement-state.v1", PlanID: plan, Status: "PLANNING_PENDING"}, nil
}
func TestDiagnosticHTTPActorAndStrictCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		role, body string
		code       int
	}{{"STUDENT", `{"plan_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"}`, 200}, {"STUDENT_PRO", `{"plan_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"}`, 200}, {"ADMIN", `{"plan_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"}`, 403}, {"", `{}`, 401}, {"STUDENT", `{"plan_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","student_id":"foreign"}`, 400}, {"STUDENT", `{} {}`, 400}} {
		t.Run(tc.role+tc.body, func(t *testing.T) {
			stub := &diagnosticHTTPStub{}
			router := httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{AdminPersonalTeacher: &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}, APIPersonalTeacher: &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}, APITeacherDialog: &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{}, APICurriculum: &apihandlers.CurriculumHandler{Diagnostic: stub}})
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/teacher/me/diagnostic-assessments/complete", strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
			request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", tc.role)
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(w, request)
			require.Equal(t, tc.code, w.Code)
			require.Zero(t, stub.planned)
			if tc.code == 200 {
				require.Equal(t, 1, stub.completed)
				require.Equal(t, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", stub.actor)
				require.Equal(t, "no-store", w.Header().Get("Cache-Control"))
			} else {
				require.Zero(t, stub.completed)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestDiagnosticHTTPExplicitAlternativeIsStrictAndDoesNotNeedLegacyPlanner(t *testing.T) {
	for _, body := range []string{`{"diagnostic_plan_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"}`, `{"diagnostic_plan_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","goal_code":""}`, `{"diagnostic_plan_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","constraints":{}}`} {
		stub := &diagnosticHTTPStub{}
		router := httptransport.NewRouter(httptransport.RouterDependencies{AdminPersonalTeacher: &adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}, APIPersonalTeacher: &apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}, APITeacherDialog: &apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler{}, APICurriculum: &apihandlers.CurriculumHandler{Diagnostic: stub}})
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/teacher/me/learning-path/plan", strings.NewReader(body))
		request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
		request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(w, request)
		if strings.Contains(body, "goal_code") || strings.Contains(body, "constraints") {
			require.Equal(t, 400, w.Code)
			require.Zero(t, stub.planned)
		} else {
			require.Equal(t, 200, w.Code)
			require.Equal(t, 1, stub.planned)
		}
		require.Zero(t, stub.completed)
	}
}
